tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: The ground every screen sits on. Cool, so warm state tints read as deliberate.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Cards, the app bar, inputs. The only pure white in the system.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Segmented-control rails, quiet informational blocks, disabled fills.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: A row inside a card that is present but not actionable — a not-yet-possible checklist item.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for a secondary or tertiary control, and for a whole row that is a link.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: The three surfaces that show machine text on purpose: build log, one-time key, repair prompt. Never for emphasis.

tokens.name: surface-inverse-deep
tokens.usage: An inset inside surface-inverse — the key itself, a code block.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind a modal that interrupts a task, such as re-authentication.

tokens.name: border-default
tokens.usage: Card edges and the app bar's bottom rule.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Dividers inside a card, and the edge of a sunken fill.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Inputs, secondary buttons, and every dashed edge that means not-yet.

tokens.name: border-hover
tokens.usage: An input or secondary button under the cursor. The only border change on hover.

tokens.name: border-muted
tokens.usage: Underlines on quiet links, and unfilled step marks.

tokens.name: border-inverse
tokens.usage: Edges inside surface-inverse.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and any sentence a person must read. 16.7:1 on surface-page.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Body copy inside a tinted block, and bolded runs inside muted prose.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Standing body copy that explains rather than instructs. 6.4:1 on surface-page.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Captions, meta lines, overlines, and mono hostnames that are not the subject. 5.0:1 — the lightest ink permitted on text.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Text inside a disabled control ONLY. Never for live copy; it does not clear 4.5:1.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: ink-inverse-muted
tokens.usage: Line numbers and already-written log lines on surface-inverse. 6.0:1.

tokens.name: ink-inverse-strong
tokens.usage: Headings and icon strokes on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: UBC Blue. The mark, every primary action, and the focus ring. An action colour, not just chrome.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and active on brand.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: A brand-tinted surface, for the rare block that is about the institution rather than about a state.

tokens.name: nav-surface
tokens.usage: The left rail's ground. An alias of brand: the rail IS the institution's colour, at full strength, on every screen.

tokens.name: nav-ink
tokens.usage: The active rail item, the wordmark, and the person's name. 12.4:1 on nav-surface.

tokens.name: nav-ink-muted
tokens.usage: An inactive rail item. 7.6:1 on nav-surface — readable, and plainly not the one you are on.

tokens.name: nav-ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Rail overlines and the sign-out link. 6.1:1 on nav-surface; never used on nav-active.

tokens.name: nav-active
tokens.usage: The fill behind the rail item you are on. White clears 8.3:1 on it.

tokens.name: nav-hover
tokens.usage: A rail item under the cursor.

tokens.name: nav-rule
tokens.usage: Dividers inside the rail. Alpha, so it holds up against every blue behind it.

tokens.name: brand-on
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand. 12.4:1.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The 2px focus outline, at 3px offset. An alias of brand, so a brand change cannot leave focus behind.

tokens.name: working
tokens.usage: State: a machine is moving and you may leave. Deliberately not the brand blue, so a status is never read as an action.

tokens.name: working-deep
tokens.usage: The filled working panel, and working text on white.

tokens.name: working-bright
tokens.usage: The light stripe of the drifting progress bar. Decorative only.

tokens.name: working-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of a working block.

tokens.name: working-border
tokens.usage: Edge of a working block.

tokens.name: waiting
tokens.usage: State: a person or an office holds this, and it is measured in days or weeks.

tokens.name: waiting-deep
tokens.usage: Headings inside a waiting block.

tokens.name: waiting-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of a waiting block.

tokens.name: waiting-border
tokens.usage: Edge of a waiting block, and the rule of an unstarted time bar.

tokens.name: waiting-hatch
tokens.usage: The diagonal fill of a clock that has not started. Never animate it.

tokens.name: attention
tokens.usage: State: stuck until a person acts. Always paired with one action and one sentence saying what is still true.

tokens.name: attention-deep
tokens.usage: Headings inside an attention block.

tokens.name: attention-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary prose inside an attention block.

tokens.name: attention-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of an attention block.

tokens.name: attention-border
tokens.usage: Edge of an attention block.

tokens.name: attention-border-soft
tokens.usage: The quiet outline of the control that OPENS a destructive confirmation. Red is spent on the confirm, not the invitation.

tokens.name: steady
tokens.usage: State: it works. The quietest of the five — steadiness needs no emphasis.

tokens.name: steady-deep
tokens.usage: Body copy inside a steady block.

tokens.name: steady-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary prose inside a steady block.

tokens.name: steady-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of a steady block, and the serving half of a two-facts pair.

tokens.name: steady-border
tokens.usage: Edge of a steady block.

tokens.name: speculative-hatch-a
tokens.usage: Light stripe of the band marking a screen with no API behind it.

tokens.name: speculative-hatch-b
tokens.usage: Dark stripe of the same band.

tokens.name: warning-mark
tokens.usage: The one-time-key warning triangle on surface-inverse. Used once, on purpose.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: The sign-in panel only. One per product.
styles.sample: Build the tool your course needs.

styles.name: moment
styles.usage: The one sentence a screen exists for — the question an agent asked, a checklist section.
styles.sample: add a member to this project

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: A group label inside a card, and a form question.

styles.name: body-lead
styles.usage: The paragraph under a page title. Cap it at about 60 characters.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: The default. Most sentences in the product are this.

styles.name: body-small
styles.usage: Explanatory prose beside a control, in ink-muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels and the text of small controls.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Meta lines: when, who, how long it has waited.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Section labels, set uppercase in ink-subtle. Never longer than three words.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Hostnames, keys, commit references. The only place mono is allowed.

styles.name: mono-address
styles.usage: The address at the moment an app first answers. The emotional payload of the journey.

styles.name: mono-log
styles.usage: Build log lines on surface-inverse. Looser leading, because it is scanned rather than read.

spacing.note: A 4px grid. The prototype these tokens were read from predates the scale and holds odd values; new work uses these.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a dot and its word.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside a chip; between sibling buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between a label and its control.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between cards, and inside a small tinted block.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding, and the gap between rows of a list.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Padding of a card that carries a heading and a decision.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between the major regions of a screen.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between the two columns of a two-column screen.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: The page gutter.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: A progress bar, a skeleton line.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: A segmented-control tab, a code block inside an inverse surface.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Every button, input and small tinted block. The most used radius in the system.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, the preview frame.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: A modal.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: State chips only.

shadow.note: Three, and the system prefers borders. A shadow means a surface is at a different depth, never that something is important.

tokens.name: shadow-raise
tokens.usage: The selected tab of a segmented control. The only shadow inside a card.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The preview frame — this is a different thing, behind glass.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: A modal over the scrim.
